d:
Hit the gas with Earth’s fastest animals in this episode of Superbeast from Nat Geo Animals, narrated by Ross Noble. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, peregrine falcons do airborne assassinations, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck g-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.
Superbeast | S1, E2 "Super Speed"
